version.reason: The release that introduces both the `blobhash` Solidity global and the Cancun Yul built-in; iterating targets shows the shadowing rejection pre-Cancun and the Yul reservation from Cancun on.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: On these pre-Cancun targets solc accepts `let blobhash := 1`, since the Yul built-in only exists from Cancun. slang rejects it as shadowing the Solidity `blobhash` global because its global lookup is not gated by version or target (the ungated `lookup_global` limitation). From Cancun on both reject it as a Yul built-in, and below Constantinople both reject because solc declines the target outright. Fixing the lookup gating will remove this divergence.
